Required gate: No fabricated customer facts, results or sources
Failure condition: Any invented measured baseline, real customer attribution or false citation.
Required remediation: Correct claims; provide scenario/evidence basis; reassess affected model/readout.

Failure condition: Unauthorized data use/disclosure or bypass of access controls.
Required remediation: Remove sensitive data; follow approved response/remediation; repeat safe-handling review.

Required gate: No unauthorized deployment or commercial commitment
Failure condition: Learner presents role-play, score or draft as actual pilot approval or signed commitment.
Required remediation: Correct decision boundaries and workflow; reassess recommendation and MAP.

Failure condition: Missing prioritized log, two workflow pairs, value model, metric plan, readout or MAP.
Required remediation: Submit missing evidence and reassess relevant dimensions.

Failure condition: Material unit/formula error, hidden double counting or unsupported technical promise left uncorrected.
Required remediation: Correct model/capability claim with reviewer evidence; rescore affected dimensions.
